items.source: Create a custom DataAccessException, based on a given exception class from a CustomSQLErrorCodesTranslation definition.
items.translation: 基于给定的异常类，根据CustomSQLErrorCodesTranslation定义创建一个自定义的DataAccessException。

items.source: as of 6.1, in favor of AbstractFallbackSQLExceptionTranslator.setCustomTranslator(SQLExceptionTranslator)
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用AbstractFallbackSQLExceptionTranslator.setCustomTranslator(SQLExceptionTranslator)。

items.source: dataSource - the DataSource to use to find meta-data and establish which error codes are usable
items.translation: dataSource - 用于查找元数据并确定哪些错误代码可用的 DataSource。

items.source: task - readable text describing the task being attempted
items.translation: task - 描述正在尝试执行的任务的可读文本

items.source: sqlEx - the offending SQLException
items.translation: sqlEx - 引发异常的 SQLException

items.source: This translator is commonly used by default if a user-provided `sql-error-codes.xml` file has been found in the root of the classpath, as a signal to use this strategy. Otherwise, SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator serves as the default translator as of 6.0.
items.translation: 如果用户在类路径根目录中找到了用户提供的 `sql-error-codes.xml` 文件，则默认使用此转换器作为使用该策略的信号。否则，自 6.0 版本起，SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator 充当默认转换器。

items.source: This class applies the following matching rules:
items.translation: 该类应用以下匹配规则：

items.source:
The configuration file named "sql-error-codes.xml" is by default read from
this package. It can be overridden through a file of the same name in the root
of the class path (for example, in the "/WEB-INF/classes" directory), as long as the
Spring JDBC package is loaded from the same ClassLoader.
items.translation: 默认情况下，名为 "sql-error-codes.xml" 的配置文件将从该包中读取。可以通过类路径根目录（例如在 "/WEB-INF/classes" 目录）中同名的文件来覆盖它，前提是 Spring JDBC 包是从同一个 ClassLoader 加载的。

items.source:
Setting this property will cause a Connection to be obtained from
the DataSource to get the meta-data.
items.translation: 设置此属性将从 DataSource 获取连接以获取元数据。

items.source:
Setting this property will avoid obtaining a Connection from the DataSource
to get the meta-data.
items.translation: 设置此属性将避免从 DataSource 获取连接以获取元数据。

items.source: Subclasses can override this method to attempt a custom mapping from SQLException to DataAccessException.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，尝试将SQLException自定义映射到DataAccessException。

items.source: Description copied from class: AbstractFallbackSQLExceptionTranslator
items.translation: 描述从类复制：AbstractFallbackSQLExceptionTranslator

items.source: Set custom error codes to be used for translation.
items.translation: 设置自定义错误代码以用于翻译。

items.source:
Constructor for use as a JavaBean.
The SqlErrorCodes or DataSource property must be set.
items.translation: 用作 JavaBean 的构造函数。必须设置 SqlErrorCodes 或 DataSource 属性。

items.source:
Create an SQL error code translator for the given DataSource.
Invoking this constructor will cause a Connection to be obtained
from the DataSource to get the meta-data.
items.translation: 为给定的 DataSource 创建一个 SQL 错误代码转换器。调用此构造函数将从 DataSource 获取一个 Connection，以获取元数据。

items.source:
Create an SQL error code translator for the given database product name.
Invoking this constructor will avoid obtaining a Connection from the
DataSource to get the meta-data.
items.translation:
为给定的数据库产品名称创建一个 SQL 错误代码转换器。
调用此构造函数将避免从 DataSource 获取 Connection 以获取元数据。

items.source:
Create an SQLErrorCode translator given these error codes.
Does not require a database meta-data lookup to be performed using a connection.
items.translation: 创建一个 SQLErrorCode 转换器，给定这些错误代码。无需使用连接执行数据库元数据查找。

items.source:
Return the error codes used by this translator.
Usually determined via a DataSource.
items.translation: 返回此翻译器使用的错误代码。通常通过 DataSource 确定。

items.source: Fallback to a fallback translator. SQLStateSQLExceptionTranslator is the default fallback translator, analyzing the exception's SQL state only. Since Java 6 which introduces its own SQLException subclass hierarchy, we use SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator by default, which in turns falls back to Spring's own SQL state translation when not encountering specific subclasses.
items.translation: 回退到回退翻译器。SQLStateSQLExceptionTranslator 是默认的回退翻译器，仅分析异常的 SQL 状态。自 Java 6 引入其自身的 SQLException 子类层次结构以来，我们默认使用SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator，该翻译器在遇到特定子类时回退到 Spring 自己的 SQL 状态翻译。

items.source: null if no custom translation applies, otherwise a DataAccessException resulting from custom translation. This exception should include the sqlEx parameter as a nested root cause. This implementation always returns null, meaning that the translator always falls back to the default error codes.
items.translation: 如果不存在适用的自定义转换，则返回null；否则，返回由自定义转换生成的DataAccessException。此异常应将sqlEx参数作为嵌套的根本原因包含在内。该实现始终返回null，这意味着转换器总是回退到默认错误代码。

items.source: doTranslate in class AbstractFallbackSQLExceptionTranslator
items.translation: `doTranslate` 类中的 `AbstractFallbackSQLExceptionTranslator`

items.source: null if the custom exception could not be created, otherwise the resulting DataAccessException. This exception should include the sqlEx parameter as a nested root cause.
items.translation: 如果无法创建自定义异常，则返回`null`；否则返回生成的DataAccessException。此异常应将sqlEx参数作为嵌套的根本原因包含在内。

items.source: exceptionClass - the exception class to use, as defined in the CustomSQLErrorCodesTranslation definition
items.translation: `exceptionClass` - 要使用的异常类，如定义在 CustomSQLErrorCodesTranslation 中所示。

items.source: sql - the SQL query or update that caused the problem (may be null)
items.translation: sql - 导致问题的 SQL 查询或更新（可能为 null）

items.source: dbName - the database product name that identifies the error codes entry
items.translation: dbName - 标识错误代码条目的数据库产品名称

items.source: sec - error codes
items.translation: sec - 错误代码

items.source: sec - custom error codes to use
items.translation: sec - 要使用的自定义错误代码

items.source:
Try custom translation implemented by any subclass. Note that this class is
concrete and is typically used itself, in which case this rule doesn't apply.
items.translation: 尝试由任何子类实现的自定义翻译。请注意，该类是具体的，通常直接使用它，在这种情况下该规则不适用。

items.source:
Apply error code matching. Error codes are obtained from the SQLErrorCodesFactory
by default. This factory loads a "sql-error-codes.xml" file from the class path,
defining error code mappings for database names from database meta-data.
items.translation: 默认应用错误代码匹配。该工厂从类路径中加载一个"sql-error-codes.xml"文件，根据数据库元数据定义数据库名称的错误代码映射。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Thomas Risberg, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Rod Johnson、Thomas Risberg、Juergen Hoeller 和 Sam Brannen

items.source: The passed-in arguments will have been pre-checked. Furthermore, this method is allowed to return null to indicate that no exception match has been found and that fallback translation should kick in.
items.translation: 传入的参数将经过预先检查。此外，此方法允许返回 `null` 以表示未找到异常匹配项，并应触发回退翻译。
